tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba bzhugs so// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba mang yang*/ 'dir yum ka'i 'pho ba la/ gzhan du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas byas kyang chog gtso cher mngon rtogs kyi mjug tu bsam mi khyab kyi mthar/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba nas spyi bo'i tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar du rtsa dbu ma drang thal le ba sba lcag tsam yar rim bzhin sbom du song ba rtse mo tshangs bug tu rgya mthong kha phye ba ltar har re yod pa/ de'i steng du bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ mtha' skor du mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin ltar gtibs pa tsam gyis bskor ba/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs bla ma la thim/ rang gi lte bar dbu ma'i sna ru chos 'byung nang du rnam shes bam̐ yig tu bsam/ lus longs spyod mchod par 'bul bar bsam ste/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ spro na/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs gsol 'debs gang shes bya/ de tsam ma byung na 'di ltar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'phyug med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab/ 'og rlung 'then tsam byas hika cig brjod pas rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig dbu ma'i nang nas yar rgya mthong la bya 'phur ba bzhin song*/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim par bsams la cung zad blo la bzhag yang bla ma'i thugs kar nas 'thon te dbu ma nas mar zhugs/ dbu ma'i mas sna chos 'byung gi nang du slebs par bsams la ngag tu ka zhes brjod/

yang sngar ltar mchod bstod gsol btab byas la bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho/ yang mar 'beb pa sogs thun re'i nang du tshar ci 'gro byed/ thun bsdu ba na/ mtha' skor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bla ma la thim/ bla ma spyi gtsug nas snying gar byon/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug 'od dmar gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyis bkag chu yang mi 'dzag rlung yang mi thar bar bsam/ rtags ma byung bar du sbyangs te/ rtags ni spyi gtsug skrangs pa dang*/ khrag thon pa/ sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa 'byung*/ las sbyor ni nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe/ bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma chad bar du yang yang bya/ mthar bla ma skar mda' 'phos pa ltar rang gang du mos pa'i zhing khams su gshegs par bsam pa'o// 'pho ba gnad du song na mkha' spyod 'grub gsungs so// zhes pa 'di'ang skul ba po'i ngor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rnal 'byor ma'i ku sā li'i tshogs bsags kyi ngag 'don bzhugs// ༈ /rang sems bam̐ yig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs bug nas 'thon te// rtsa ba'i bla ma zhal sbyor bzhugs pa yis// phan tshun bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur// rang sems ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// rang gi tha mal phung po la gzigs pas// che zhing snum la tsho bar 'dug pa de// sngar nas 'di 'dra'i lus kun don med song*// da lan don chen bya 'o snyam dgongs nas// phung po'i rtsar byon gri gug rnon po yis// tha mal lus su snang ba'i sogs nas/ nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag gnyis mgo bo'i lhag ma bcas// de nang bskyur bas sha khrag rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ las chos dbyings sogs nas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i sogs/ 'di yang bya bral sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// sogs khong lam zab ltar ro// dmigs pa khrid yig tu blta'o// maṅga laṃ//

༈ /rnal 'byor ma'i lus dkyil ngag 'don ni// ༈ /bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su bsgoms kyang chog gsungs/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i rjes su bsgoms kyang chog gsungs/ ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ snying ga'i chos 'byung gi zla ba'i dbus kyi bam̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las dbus su srog yig a thung*/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yon bskor gyi ya ra la wa/ de rnams rang gnas su lhar gyur pa ni/ dbus su bam̐ yig gi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ shar du ya'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dkar mo/ g.yon du ra yi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ljang khu/ rgyab tu la'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ g.yas su wa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ser mo/ mtha' skor gyi oṃ oṃ oṃ la sogs pa'i yi ge sum cu so gnyis yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma dmar mo sum cu so gnyis te/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun po thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi'i rnal 'byor ma dang mtshungs pa/ rnal 'byor ma dbu ma'i thugs kar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba sngags phreng*/ dbus su bam̐ yig dang bcas pa ste 'khor lo lnga brtsegs gsal bar gyur/ zhes pas gsal btab/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe rnal 'byor ma dbus ma'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo lnga brtsegs las spro bsdu sogs byed pa yin zhing rgyu mtshan rgyas pa rnam bshad du blta'o// zhes pa 'di yang bskul ngor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rnal 'byor ma'i nyer mkho'i zin bris bzhugs so// ༈ /rnal 'byor ma'i zin bris rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob mkhas grub gzhon nu seṅge'i gsung la/ nam mkha' chos bzang dpal gyis zin bris mdzad par/ mthun rkyen 'dzom zhing gnas dben par bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ skyabs yul bla ma rdo rje chos kyi sku la rigs lnga sogs sangs rgyas dkon mchog thugs rgyud lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos dkon mchog

skye mched dang tshigs sogs byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bor bzhugs pa dge 'dun dkon mchog skyabs sems kyi dmigs bskor gcig yig brgya spyi mthun maṇ+ḍal dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyogs gcig tu mdzad par/ sngar gyi skyabs 'gro'i yul de nyid rang gi spyi bor bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams spyan drangs te/ de la thim par bsam/ yid rtse gcig tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus gsol ba btab/ maṇ+ḍal ci 'grub/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsgoms la dbang bzhi blangs/ bla ma rang la bstim/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar bam̐/ grwa drug la dga' ba 'khyil pa re re/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rgyu bskyed rim/ 'bras bu rdzogs rim mo// dang po la gsum/ rim gyi gsal gdab pa dang*/ sems 'dzin pa'o// dang po ni/ snying ga'i chos 'byung gi bam̐ yig de phru ma phus btab pa bzhin je cher song nas mthar yangs shing rgya che bar bsgom/ rgyud gzhan du swa bhā wa bshad pa'i dod/ de'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa bam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las so// pad zlar ro// rgyan med/ rgyan can no// zhag bdun bdun nas dmigs pa spo'o// rdzogs rim gyi skabs su rje btsun gyi khrid yig tu/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi thig le dbus su bsgom par bshad kyang de'i man ngag gab pa yin gyi/ drod bskyed pa'i gdams ngag yin pas me rlung dbus su bsgom gsungs so// rlung kha sbyar la lag pa g.yon pas phreng ba bzung g.yas se gol lo// 'di rnams zhag bdun ma mtha'o// yang yi ge'i thig le la dmigs pa dor/ ham̐ k+ṣum̐ sogs 'bar 'dzag dmigs skor gcig gam gzhan la ston pa'i tshe dmigs thun re re'i 'gor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa bsgom/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang*/

rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam byed do// goms nas thun gcig la dmigs pa rnams skyong ba yin no// zhes pa 'di'ang rnal 'byor ma'i zin bris su chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis smras pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
